case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO.6511 OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(C)No.30005 of 2019) AND CIVIL APPEAL NO.6512 OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(C)No.2649 of 2020)

parties.petitioner: Tamil Nadu Medical Services Corporation Limited
parties.respondent: Tamil Nadu Medical Services Corporation Employees Welfare Union & Anr.

summary: The appeals concerned the applicability of the Tamil Nadu Industrial Establishments (Conferment of Permanent Status to Workmen) Act, 1981 to the Tamil Nadu Medical Services Corporation. The key issues were whether the Corporation qualified as an 'industrial establishment' under the Act and whether the Inspector of Labour's order conferring permanent status on certain workmen was valid. The High Court had upheld the Inspector's order, which granted permanent status to 53 workmen. This Court previously remanded the matter in 2016 for fresh consideration, directing the High Court to examine the applicability of the Act. On remand, the High Court reaffirmed the Act's applicability, observing that the Corporation met the definition of an industrial establishment under Section 2(3)(e) of the Act. The appellants challenged non-compliance with the 2016 order, arguing the Act did not apply, especially given construction-related exemptions, and that some workmen had secured alternate employment. Respondents relied on precedents supporting regularization after long service. The Court examined statutory applicability and principles of equitable employment.
legal_provisions_cited: Tamil Nadu Industrial Establishments (Conferment of Permanent Status to Workmen) Act, 1981
Tamil Nadu Shops and Establishments Act, 1947
Article 14 of the Constitution of India
State of Karnataka v. Uma Devi
Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation v. Casteribe Rajya Parivahan Karmachari Sanghathana
U.P. Power Corporation Limited & Anr. v. Bijli Mazdoor Sangh & Ors.
final_judgment: The Supreme Court upheld the High Court's judgment, confirming the applicability of the Tamil Nadu Industrial Establishments (Conferment of Permanent Status to Workmen) Act, 1981 to the Corporation and directing the regularization of the eligible workmen as per law.
